name: chatty-bugfix
why: The common case: a real ask buried in greeting, hedging and meta-instructions.
prompt: hey claude! hope you're doing well. so i think maybe the login thing is broken? it 500s when the token is expired and it should really just be a 401. please be careful not to break anything and think step by step. thanks so much!

name: terse-bugfix
why: Already tight. The pass should add done-criteria, not subtract, so triage is light.
prompt: auth middleware rejects valid tokens after midnight UTC

name: credentials-in-prompt
why: Ugly case. A pasted key must be detected so the rewrite strips it and nothing lands in memory.
prompt: the deploy keeps failing, here is the config we use: AWS_SECRET=AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE and the db is at postgres://admin:hunter2@db.internal:5432/app - figure out why the migration step dies

name: destructive-ops
why: Guardrail case: the rewrite has to name the specific destructive action to confirm.
prompt: clean up the old release branches and drop the legacy_sessions table from production, then redeploy
known_gap: classified `refactor`: 'clean up' matches the refactor keyword and outranks the drop-table/production/redeploy signals. Should be `ops`. Risk flags fire correctly, so the guardrail still holds; only the reply budget and rule sort are wrong. `clean up the old release branches` also raises no `delete` flag: the pattern wants an explicit delete verb.

name: several-independent-tasks
why: Numbered steps, not one blurred task. Every ask has to survive the rewrite.
prompt: add a --json flag to the export command, and then update the changelog for it, and also bump the version to 2.4.0 before you finish the whole thing off

name: also-explain-is-not-a-second-task
why: `also explain` is an output request on one task; splitting it into steps is the failure mode.
prompt: cache the user lookup in the profile endpoint so repeated hits don't re-query, and also explain what you changed and why it is safe under concurrent requests
known_gap: classified `explain`: the trailing output request outscores the task itself. SKILL.md step 2 says an 'also explain' is an output request for the one task, so the heuristic contradicts the documented intent. Should be `feature`.

name: pasted-code-block
why: Pasted code should be recognised so the rewrite can point at a path instead of re-pasting.
prompt:
this function is wrong somehow:

```python
def refresh_token(session):
    if session.expires_at < now():
        raise Error('expired')
    return session.token
```

it throws a plain Error and the caller turns that into a 500

name: named-file-that-does-not-exist
why: A path the user misremembered must become a locate-first step, never an assumption.
prompt: update the retry logic in src/net/retry_policy.ts so it backs off exponentially instead of a flat 200ms

name: restates-claude-md
why: Context already in CLAUDE.md is duplicated context; the analysis has to spot the sentence.
prompt: add a health check endpoint. remember that we always run the full test suite before committing and that every new endpoint needs an entry in the OpenAPI spec.
claude_md: We always run the full test suite before committing. Every new endpoint needs an entry in the OpenAPI spec.

name: acknowledgement
why: Rewriting an ack costs a turn instead of saving one.

name: question-not-a-task
why: Explain-type work gets a prose budget, not a files-changed report.
prompt: why does the scheduler run every job twice on the first tick after a restart? walk me through what happens during startup

name: review-with-scope-boundary
why: An explicit boundary is never optimised away.
prompt: review the changes on this branch for correctness only - do not touch the formatting and do not refactor anything while you are in there
known_gap: classified `refactor` off the word in 'do not refactor anything'. Keyword counting has no notion of negation, and refactor wins the tie-break against review. Should be `review`.
